message.airswap.swapped: Air Swap: mace in hotbar slot %s
config.airswap.title: Air Swap Settings — v%s
config.airswap.warning: Combat automation may violate server rules. Use only where explicitly permitted. Damage is decided by the server.
config.airswap.category.swap.tooltip: Configure automatic returns, mace selection, and Breach behavior.
config.airswap.category.weapons.tooltip: Choose which swords and spears can trigger an Air Swap.
config.airswap.category.triggers.tooltip: Limit when an attack can trigger a weapon swap.
config.airswap.category.qol.tooltip: Optional gameplay filters to make swaps more deliberate.
config.airswap.group.swap.tooltip: Control the automatic weapon change and return timing.
config.airswap.group.mace.tooltip: Select which eligible mace is used and where it may be found.
config.airswap.group.swords.tooltip: Configure sword-tag support or an allowlist of sword items.
config.airswap.group.spears.tooltip: Enable or disable spear-to-mace swapping independently of swords.
config.airswap.group.qol.tooltip: Optional filters and mace durability preferences for more deliberate swaps.
config.airswap.enabled.tooltip: Master switch, shared with the toggle keybind. New configurations start enabled. Combat automation may be prohibited on public servers.
config.airswap.swap_back: Return to original weapon after attack
config.airswap.swap_back.tooltip: Return to the original sword or spear after the attack call, whether it hits or misses. Manual slot changes cancel the return; opening a screen pauses it until the player inventory is safe.
config.airswap.swap_back_delay.tooltip: Wait 0–10 client ticks after the attack call before returning, whether the attack hits or misses. Zero (default) restores immediately for the quickest follow-up. Packets remain ordered, but server timing may differ.
config.airswap.players_only.tooltip: Only attacks against players trigger a swap. Disable to allow attacks against other entities too.
config.airswap.minimum_fall_distance.too: Require at least this much accumulated fall distance. Zero also allows airborne attacks while rising. Vanilla mace smash eligibility is still checked by the server.
config.airswap.allow_spears.tooltip: When enabled, a held vanilla or modded spear in the minecraft:spears tag can trigger a mace swap. Disable this to limit swaps to swords. The server still controls attack and smash results.
config.airswap.allow_while_gliding.toolt: Allow the swap while using an elytra. This only selects the mace for the attack; it cannot force a mace smash or bypass server rules.
config.airswap.require_breach_mace.toolt: Only swap when a vanilla mace with Breach is available in the searched inventory range. No unenchanted-mace fallback is used. When enabled, the preference option below is not needed.
config.airswap.prefer_breach_mace.toolti: When Breach is not required, choose a Breach-enchanted vanilla mace ahead of other maces. If none is found, use another eligible mace.
config.airswap.all_swords.tooltip: Accept every item in the minecraft:swords tag, including correctly tagged modded swords. Disable to use the allowed-swords list instead.
config.airswap.allowed_swords.tooltip: Used when all swords is disabled. Example: minecraft:diamond_sword, minecraft:netherite_sword. Entries must still be in the swords tag. Invalid IDs are ignored; an empty list permits no swords.
config.airswap.only_hotbar: Only swap if mace is in hotbar
config.airswap.only_hotbar.tooltip: Use the first mace in hotbar slots 1–9. If disabled and none is there, swap the first main-inventory mace into the held weapon's slot using a normal inventory SWAP click. With swap-back enabled, that inventory exchange is reversed afterward if safe. Offhand is never searched.
config.airswap.show_swap_message.tooltip: Display a short action-bar message identifying the selected mace slot. Toggle-key messages always display.
config.airswap.disable_when_sneaking.too: Do not trigger a new swap while sneaking. Does not cancel the underlying attack.
config.airswap.cooldown_ticks.tooltip: Minimum 0–20 client ticks between successful swaps. This does not change vanilla attack cooldown or bypass server checks.
config.airswap.only_while_falling.toolti: Wait until you are moving downward before swapping. Useful for avoiding mace swaps while jumping or rising.
config.airswap.require_attack_cooldown.t: Swap only when vanilla's attack cooldown is at least 90% ready, helping avoid wasting a mace hit on a weak cooldown attack.
config.airswap.require_line_of_sight.too: Do not swap when the target is not visible to the player, reducing unnecessary swaps against blocked targets.
config.airswap.avoid_nearly_broken_maces: Skip maces with 5% durability or less (at least one durability point). If no eligible mace remains, no swap is performed.
Choose the eligible mace with the most durability remaining. Breach preference or requirement still takes priority when applicable.
config.airswap.reset.tooltip: Immediately restore and save all Air Swap settings, then refresh this screen. Does not change the keybind in Minecraft Controls.
